# Implementation Plan: CLI Record & Derive Commands

**Branch**: `001-cli-record-derive` | **Date**: 2026-08-08 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-cli-record-derive/spec.md`

**Note**: This file was generated by `/speckit-plan`. Phase 2 task generation is handled by `/speckit-tasks`.

## Summary

Add two new CLI subcommands (`rgt record` and `rgt derive`) to enable rules-file agents (Kilo Code, Windsurf) to populate the provenance graph without automatic hook interception. `rgt record` extracts numeric/date values from files and upserts root nodes, reusing the existing extraction engine from passive hooks. `rgt derive` performs verify-then-record: it evaluates an expression or date-diff against parent node values, and only inserts a derived node with derivation edges if verification succeeds. Both commands follow existing conventions for exit codes, DB access, and error messages.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Rust 2021 edition (Cargo 1.94.0 toolchain)

**Primary Dependencies**: clap 4.5 (CLI parsing), rusqlite 0.31 (bundled SQLite), chrono 0.4 (date handling), evalexpr 13.1 (expression evaluation), regex 1.10 (value extraction), blake3 1.5 (hashing/node IDs), petgraph 0.6 (graph structure)

**Storage**: SQLite via rusqlite (bundled, WAL mode) → `.rgt/store.db`, schema already contains `tracked_nodes`, `derivation_edges`, `source_documents`

**Testing**: `cargo test` with three test categories: unit (`tests/unit/`), contract (`tests/contract/`), integration (`tests/integration/`)

**Target Platform**: macOS (aarch64/x86_64), Linux (x86_64/aarch64), Windows (x86_64) — single binary, zero runtime deps

**Project Type**: Single Rust binary CLI tool

**Performance Goals**: `rgt record` completes within 1 second for typical files (<10k values per SC-001); `rgt derive` verification + insert completes in <100ms

**Constraints**: Zero external runtime dependencies (Constitution I); CLI exit codes 0/1/2 (Constitution XI); no MCP, no new hook protocols

**Scale/Scope**: Handles files up to 10 MB extractable content (10k values × ~1KB per value line); derived nodes limited only by graph storage capacity; typical provenance graphs <100k nodes (per Constitution latency budget)

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| I. Rust-Only Single Binary | ✅ PASS | New commands are Rust CLI subcommands in the existing binary; no new runtime deps |
| II. Two-Tier Detection & BLAKE3 | ✅ PASS | `rgt record` reuses existing `get_metadata_snapshot` + `compute_blake3_hash`; no new detection code |
| III. Graph Correctness & Subgraph Invalidation | ✅ PASS | `rgt derive` inserts derived nodes + edges using existing `insert_derivation_edge`; staleness cascade covers derived nodes without changes |
| IV. Rich Value Types | ✅ PASS | Both commands support Number, Date (from extraction engine), and Duration (from DATE_DIFF derivation) |
| V. Multi-Channel Distribution | ✅ PASS | New subcommands are included in the binary distributed via all channels; `rgt init` template updated |
| VI. CLI-First Integration Surface | ✅ PASS | Both commands are CLI subcommands; `rgt record` mirrors the extraction path from passive hooks but is explicitly invoked |
| VII. Permissive OSS License | ✅ PASS | No new third-party dependencies; existing deps all MIT/Apache-2.0 compatible |
| VIII. CLI-First Hook Architecture | ✅ PASS | Business logic (extraction, verification, insert) stays in Rust binary; AGENTS.md template is thin instruction text |
| IX. Test-Driven Verification | ✅ PASS | Tests will be added in `tests/contract/` and `tests/unit/` following existing patterns; deterministic, no wall-clock or network deps |
| X. Documentation Matches Behavior | ✅ PASS | AGENTS.md template updated (FR-009); README will be updated; `rgt --help` lists new commands (FR-010) |
| XI. Code Quality & Idiomatic Rust | ✅ PASS | New modules follow existing module organization; clippy + fmt enforced; exit codes 0/1/2 match convention |

**Gate Result**: PASS — all 11 principles satisfied. No violations to justify.
